question: Should OpenClaw core own a narrowed capability-projection CLI built from canonical effective inventory and uniquely identified trajectory turns?
rationale: The linked issue is explicitly waiting on product and security direction, while this branch creates a substantial permanent audit authority rather than a thin view over existing owner surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor a thin canonical report
options.body: Approve the feature after unique turn identity and canonical effective-tool inventory become the report authority.

options.title: Accept a separate audit authority
options.body: Explicitly own synchronization, privacy, and semantic risk for the independent taxonomy and evidence model.

options.title: Pause the direction

recommendation.body: Approve the feature after unique turn identity and canonical effective-tool inventory become the report authority.
